data.title: The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Congratulates Dr. Denis Bećirović on Taking Constitutional Oath as Member of Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques King Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud sent a cable of congratulations to Dr. Denis Bećirović on taking the constitutional oath as a member of the Presidency of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
    The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques extended his sincere congratulations and best wishes for his success and for further progress and prosperity for the friendly people of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
    -- SPA
21:22 Local Time 18:22 GMT
